versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Connection setup" section to SKILL.md, providing guidance on connecting the Covision MCP server via OAuth and referencing setup instructions in the Covision Agent Plugin repository.
- No other changes to functionality or operating rules.

Initial release of Covision skill.

- Enables users to prepare for client work using Covision tasks, meetings, and published knowledge accessible to the signed-in user.
- Supports meeting preparation, assigned-task review, and targeted knowledge searches.
- Enforces confidentiality and strict use of only accessible Covision data.
- Read-only access: skill will not imply data modification or creation.
- Clear handling of unavailable access and provides source citations where possible.
